description: Dashboard Module (FRD V0.1) — 4 KPI cards + 4 charts + one consolidated filterable 'All Activity' table; global period filter, department filter (PMO/TM/EM only), Upcoming Changes filter, Export Data (CSV/Excel). APIs: GET /api/v1/dashboard/overview, GET /api/v1/dashboard/activity on https://simerp-dev-api.simform.solutions
edgeCases: Search box receives a script or SQL payload — must echo as escaped literal text, return non-5xx, and never widen the result set.
Search with no matches must show an explicit 'no records' state while keeping the 8 column headers visible.
Search term padded with whitespace must return the same rows as the trimmed term; non-ASCII terms must not throw an encoding error.
Department + Status + Search applied together must intersect (AND); each added filter can only narrow, never restore, the row count.
Changing the global period must not silently reset an active department selection to 'All Departments'.
A department with zero records in the selected period must show zeroed KPIs and empty-but-valid charts, not an error or a collapsed chart.
Filter switch must never leave a pre-filter KPI value or table row on screen once loading resolves.
Activity API returns 5939 records across 60 pages for PMO/this_year — the UI paginates behind the scenes, so pagination integrity (no duplicate, no skipped record) needs its own coverage.
Rapid scrolling of the All Activity table must not request the same page number twice.
Sorting a column must sort the whole dataset server-side; client-side sort over a partially loaded page is a correctness defect.
Activity API limit beyond the server maximum (e.g. 100000), 0, or negative must be clamped or rejected, never returning the full unbounded set.
overview projectLimit=999999 / -1 / non-numeric must be clamped or rejected while otherProjects/totalProjectCount stay arithmetically consistent.
Malformed, injected, or reversed custom-range dates must yield 400 or a safe normalised 200 — never a 500 or a stack trace.
Scope-widening query params (departmentId, employeeId, userId, scope=all, portalWide=true) must not widen a response beyond the caller's token-derived authority.
Unauthenticated calls to the overview/activity endpoints must return 401/403 with no allocation data in the body.
After logout, direct navigation and browser Back to /dashboard must not resurface cached KPI or table data.
An invalid/expired token mid-session must trigger re-auth, not a half-rendered dashboard or a permanent spinner.
A record dated exactly on a period boundary must be counted in exactly one of two adjacent periods, and counts must be timezone-independent (resolved server-side).
Fractional hours must round identically in the KPI card, the charts and the export — no drift between surfaces.
Negative Net Utilisation must carry an explicit minus sign in text (not colour alone) and agree with the API's netDirection.
A period narrow enough to return exactly one trend bucket must still render axes and a labelled data point.
Trend chart x-axis label count and format must match the granularity the API actually returned, per period option.
Three quick period switches must render only the last selection — a slower earlier response must not win the race.
An activity-API failure must degrade only the table; the overview-driven KPI cards and charts must still render.
A slow API must keep the loading state — it must never be presented as an empty 'no data' state.
Export in a zero-data scope must produce a headers-only parseable file, not a zero-byte or corrupt download.
Export must honour the department filter as well as the period filter.
Cancelling the export dialog (button or Escape) must download nothing and leave filter state untouched.
TM/EM department filter option lists must be strict, non-empty subsets of the PMO list; PM and CSM must have no department combobox at all.
FRD Section 6.1's 'Till Date' period option does not exist live — the popover exposes exactly 6 options.
FRD OQ-D02 (default landing screen) is still unconfirmed — landing behaviour per role is to be recorded, not asserted.
businessRules: Net Utilisation must always equal Total Allocation minus Total Deallocation, and its rendered sign must match the API's netDirection.
Role scoping is derived server-side from the session token: PMO (org-wide) > EM/TM (own department(s)) > CSM/PM (own/assigned projects) > Employee (own allocations). No query param may override it.

Every number rendered on the dashboard must be traceable to the overview or activity API response for the same filter combination — KPI cards, chart values, chart tooltips, and export contents included.
Export contents must reflect the full active filter set (period + department + any table filter) and stay within the caller's permitted view authority.
The same raw API value must round identically wherever it is displayed — card, chart, CSV and Excel must agree.
Both export formats (CSV and Excel) must contain the same five sections: Summary, Trend, Allocation Type, Hours by Project, All Activity.
Filters compose as AND, never as replacement; clearing one filter must not reset the others.
Date-range boundaries are resolved server-side, so results must not vary with the client's timezone.
Chart data must be reachable by assistive technology — an unlabelled canvas with no text alternative does not satisfy AC5-AC8.
Sort and pagination are properties of the whole result set, not of the currently loaded page.
